ACT XLVI OF 2016
ACT XLVI OF 2016
PAKISTAN ENGINEERING
COUNCIL (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act further to amend
the Pakistan
Engineering Council Act, 1976
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
1st December, 2016]
No.
F. 9(28)/2016-Legis, dated 1.12.2016.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on 29th November, 2016 and is
hereby published for general information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Engineering Council Act, 1976 (V
of 1976) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Pakistan Engineering Council (Amendment) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 9, Act V of 1976

2. Amendment of section 9, Act V of 1976.---In the Pakistan
Engineering Council Act, 1976 (V of 1976), in section 9, in
subsection (2),--
(i) the commas and words ,besides Registrar,
shall be omitted;
(ii) for the word sixty-five , the word
sixty-six shall be substituted; and
(iii) after clause (e), the following new clause
shall be inserted, namely:-
(ea) Engineer-in-Chief,
Pakistan Army; .
